description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 12

Whenever the red mage enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he may spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add either the abyssal, anarchic, axiomatic, holy, shining, or unholy special ability to the list of available options. A red mage may only add one of these abilities if it matches his own alignment.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
